visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back with two large red bows on either side of her head is shown in a close-up shot. She is touching her cheek with her hand, displaying a mint green and black manicure. Her facial expression is curious and engaged. The background is a dimly lit indoor room with warm lighting. (2) The shot widens slightly to show her wearing white polka-dot pajamas. She holds a black and gold product box labeled 'CQ FOUNDATION' towards the camera. The setting appears to be a bedroom with a bed and headboard visible in the background. (3) The camera focuses on the woman's hand as she presses the pump of a foundation bottle, dispensing a small amount of beige liquid onto the back of her hand. (4) She uses her finger to spread the foundation on her hand, demonstrating its texture. The lighting is bright and direct on her skin. (5) She is seen applying the foundation to her face using a dense, black-handled makeup brush. A split-screen effect appears, labeling one side 'After' and the other 'Before' to compare skin texture. (6) The woman holds up a gold-rimmed powder compact. She opens it and uses a black puff to apply powder to her face. (7) In a different setting, she is in a bathroom with yellow shower curtains. She splashes water onto her face from a sink, demonstrating the product's water resistance. (8) She returns to the bedroom setting, holding a tray with several CQ makeup products, including the foundation, powder, and brush, smiling broadly at the camera.
